title: 第451章 可以治第450章 丹王之子
slug: 分手后我聘上女同学妈妈小司机
content_zh:
另边，半山别墅区。
独栋豪宅气派恢弘，庭院灯火通明。
路灯洒落暖黄灯光，将整片院落照得透亮，环境奢华静谧。
别墅大门前，一名年轻男子端坐于特制的高档轮椅上，正是丹王之子聂天。
他身着一身素雅名贵的白锦长衫，面料质感细腻，五官俊秀精致，自带世家贵气，只是面色略显苍白，眉宇间萦绕着几分孤傲与不耐。
他双腿盖着柔软绒毯，常年无法行走，周身透着久居病榻的孱弱感，却又因丹王后人的身份，自带一股高高在上的傲气。
身后推着轮椅的少女名为梦遥，一身干净利落的浅灰色工装套装，长发束成高马尾，眉眼清秀干练，身姿挺拔，是聂天的专属助手，做事沉稳细致，始终安静伫立待命。
聂天看着纳兰秋水打完电话收起手机，眉头紧蹙，语气带着明显的厌烦，对着身后的梦遥开口：“我们走吧，没时间在这里跟她耗着。”
纳兰秋水见状，连忙上前一步，身姿窈窕，直接挡在轮椅前方，拦住了两人的去路。
一旁伫立的护法杨邪瞬间走上前来。
他身形高大魁梧，一身黑色劲装勾勒出紧实的肌肉线条，面容冷硬凌厉，眼神凶狠锐利，浑身散发着久经厮杀的强悍气场。
杨邪往前踏出一步，气场全开，厉声低喝：“让开！”
纳兰秋水面色不改，依旧诚恳劝说：“聂少，你再等等，陈少马上就过来，他身怀顶级治疗仙术，一定可以治好你的腿疾。”
聂天眼底满是不屑与不耐，语气冰冷敷衍：“我的腿顽疾多年，寻访过无数名医高人，都束手无策，要是能治好，早就痊愈了，轮得到别人来插手？”
“别耽误我的正事，赶紧滚开！”聂天语气愈发急躁。
纳兰秋水不肯放弃，认真开口提醒：“聂少，你刚刚明明说过，只要我能找人治好你的腿，就赠予我一瓶半仙品丹药，这话还算数吗？”
聂天嗤笑一声，眉眼带着几分戏谑与轻视：“我刚才只是随口客套一句，你怎么还当真了？”
“聂少，我没有开玩笑。”纳兰秋水神色郑重，语气笃定，“我的朋友精通顶尖治疗仙术，真的可以治好你的腿。
请你再给我一点时间，他已经在赶来的路上，很快就到。”
聂天彻底失去耐心，冷冷开口：“我没空陪你浪费时间，我还有要事，必须马上走。”

说完，他再度对着身后的梦遥吩咐：“走！”
梦遥闻言，不再迟疑，双手稳稳握住轮椅扶手，缓缓推动轮椅，朝着不远处等候的黑色豪华豪车走去。
纳兰秋水不肯眼睁睁错失机缘，当即迈步上前，打算再次阻拦。
就在这时，一旁的护法杨邪骤然发力，周身爆发一股雄浑强劲的灵力威压。
厚重磅礴的气场瞬间笼罩全场。
纳兰秋水心头一沉，瞬间被这股威压锁定，身躯微微紧绷，能清晰感知到对方的实力极强，绝对不在自己之下，根本不好招惹。
杨邪眼神冷冽，淡淡开口警告：“纳兰夫人，还请止步，不要让我难做。”
说完，他紧随在轮椅身侧，准备护送聂天上车离开。
content_en:
On the other side, there is the mid-level villa area.
The single-family mansion is magnificent and the courtyard is brightly lit.
The street lamps shed warm yellow light, illuminating the entire courtyard, creating a luxurious and quiet environment.
In front of the villa gate, a young man sat in a special high-end wheelchair. It was Nie Tian, ​​the son of King Dan.
He was wearing a simple and elegant white brocade gown, the fabric was of fine texture, his facial features were handsome and exquisite, and he had the aristocratic air of aristocratic family, but his face was slightly pale, and there was a bit of aloofness and impatience lingering between his brows.
His legs were covered with a soft velvet blanket, and he had been unable to walk all year round. He had the frailty of being on a sickbed for a long time, but because of his status as Queen Dan's descendant, he also carried a sense of arrogance.
The girl pushing the wheelchair behind her is named Mengyao. She is dressed in a clean light gray work suit. Her long hair is tied into a high ponytail. She has delicate and capable eyebrows and a tall posture. She is Nie Tian's exclusive assistant. She works calmly and meticulously, and always stands quietly and is on standby.
Nie Tian watched Nalan Qiu Shui put away the phone after finishing the call, frowning, and with obvious boredom in his tone, he said to Mengyao behind him: "Let's go, we don't have time to waste here with her."
Upon seeing this, Nalan Qiushui quickly stepped forward, her graceful figure stood directly in front of the wheelchair, blocking the way of the two of them.
Protector Yang Xie, who was standing aside, stepped forward instantly.
He is tall and burly, wearing a black outfit that outlines tight muscle lines. His face is cold and sharp, his eyes are fierce and sharp, and he exudes a strong aura that has been fought for a long time.
Yang Xie took a step forward, with full aura, and shouted sternly: "Get out of the way!"
Nalan Qiushui's expression did not change, and he continued to persuade sincerely: "Master Nie, just wait, Master Chen will be here soon. He has top-notch healing skills, and he will definitely be able to cure your leg disease."
Nie Tian's eyes were full of disdain and impatience, and his tone was cold and perfunctory: "I have been suffering from leg problems for many years. I have visited countless famous doctors, but I have been unable to do anything. If it could be cured, I would have been cured long ago. Is it someone else's turn to intervene?"
"Don't delay my business, get out of here!" Nie Tian's tone became more and more impatient.
Nalan Qiushui refused to give up and reminded her seriously: "Master Nie, you just said clearly that as long as I can find someone to cure your leg, you will give me a bottle of semi-immortal elixir. Does this still count?"
Nie Tian sneered, with a hint of teasing and contempt in his eyes: "I just said it casually, why did you take it seriously?"
"Master Nie, I'm not joking." Nalan Qiushui looked solemn and said with determination, "My friend is proficient in top-notch healing magic and can really heal your legs.
Please give me a little more time. He is already on his way and will be there soon. "
Nie Tian completely lost his patience and said coldly: "I don't have time to waste time with you. I have something important to do and must leave right away."
After saying that, he once again ordered Mengyao behind him: "Let's go!"
Mengyao heard the words and no longer hesitated. He firmly grasped the armrests of the wheelchair with both hands and slowly pushed the wheelchair towards the black luxury car waiting not far away.
Nalan Qiushui was unwilling to miss the opportunity and immediately stepped forward, planning to stop him again.
At this moment, the protector Yang Xie on the side suddenly exerted his strength, and a powerful spiritual force burst out all over his body.
A thick and majestic aura instantly enveloped the entire place.
Nalan Qiushui's heart sank, and he was instantly locked by this coercion. His body tensed slightly, and he could clearly sense that the opponent was extremely powerful, definitely not inferior to him, and was not easy to provoke at all.
Yang Xie's eyes were cold and he warned calmly: "Mrs. Nalan, please stop and don't make it difficult for me."
After saying that, he followed closely beside the wheelchair, preparing to escort Nie Tian into the car and leave.
